text:
What can I say other than thank you? What a great turnout! I say it every time, and it just keeps getting better and better. I truly mean it. Thank you for dressing up, buying raffle tickets, and being part of the day! This truly fuels us to keep doing this!

Thank you to all those who donated prizes and raffle items!
